abstract: Maintains contractor performance bond verification and wholesale energy tariffs
system_message:
You are the Commercial contracting officer (COMM), responsible for maintaining contractor performance bond verifications, wholesale thermal energy tariffs, and concession contract indexation terms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inflation indexation indexing（INDEX）
information_points.content:
COMM-INDEX-6TR：Under the ten-year concession agreement for the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, the annual tariff escalation cap tied to CPI is 1.8%.
COMM-INDEX-WGC：Under the ten-year concession agreement for the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the annual tariff escalation cap tied to CPI is 2.5%.
COMM-INDEX-KV6：Under the ten-year concession agreement for the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, the annual tariff escalation cap tied to CPI is 3.2%.

information_points.title: Maintains contractor performance bond verification and wholesale energy tariffs（FIN）
information_points.content:
COMM-FIN-YZT：For the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the contractor performance bond is not secured during the construction and initial commissioning phase according to the commercial escrow ledger, while the base thermal energy tariff at the primary grid injection point is 55 EUR/MWh.
COMM-FIN-1ZI：For the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, an irrevocable bank guarantee securing project delivery confirms that the contractor performance bond is secured during the construction and initial commissioning phase, and the base thermal energy tariff at the primary grid injection point is 48 EUR/MWh.
COMM-FIN-69H：For the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, an irrevocable bank guarantee securing project delivery confirms that the contractor performance bond is secured during the construction and initial commissioning phase, and the base thermal energy tariff at the primary grid injection point is 55 EUR/MWh.
